title: When two or more sourceDescriptions are provided with (local) OpenAPI specs, only the first spec's base URL is shown in dry-run for all calls by OperationId.

raw.title: When two or more sourceDescriptions are provided with (local) OpenAPI specs, only the first spec's base URL is shown in dry-run for all calls by OperationId.
raw.body:
### Description

Taking the test example of multi-api-orchestration.arazzo.yaml & modifying the sourceDescriptions to point at OpenApi specs
`sourceDescriptions:
  - name: primary
    url: ./swagger-petstore.openapi.json
    type: openapi
  - name: tertiary
    url: ./swagger-petstore2.openapi.json
    type: openapi
`
Where swagger-petstore2.openapi.json is a copy of swagger-petstore.openapi.json with a different base URL & operationIds set to 'blah-blah2', then adding two steps to the arazzo yaml:
`      - stepId: call-primary
        operationId: "getPetById"
        parameters:
          - name: petId
            in: path
            value: "123"
        successCriteria:
          - condition: $statusCode == 200
        outputs:
          source: $response.body.args.source
          url: $url

      - stepId: call-tertiary
        operationId: "getPetById2"
        parameters:
          - name: petId
            in: path
            value: "123"
        successCriteria:
          - condition: $statusCode == 200
        outputs:
          source: $response.body.args.source
          url: $url
`
Outputs the same dryrun URL for the two calls.

### Command

```bash
cargo run -p arazzo-cli -- run --dry-run examples/multi-api-orchestration.arazzo.yaml cross-source-check
```

### Output

```json
GET https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/pet/123

GET https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/pet/123
```

### Minimal Arazzo spec

```yaml
arazzo: 1.0.0
info:
  title: Multi API Orchestration
  version: 1.0.0
  description: >
    Runs steps against named source descriptions and combines the results into
    a single workflow output contract.

sourceDescriptions:
  - name: primary
    url: ./swagger-petstore.openapi.json
    type: openapi
  - name: tertiary
    url: ./swagger-petstore2.openapi.json
    type: openapi

workflows:
  - workflowId: cross-source-check
    summary: Route steps to named sources and combine outputs
    steps:
      - stepId: call-primary
        operationId: "getPetById"
        parameters:
          - name: petId
            in: path
            value: "123"
        successCriteria:
          - condition: $statusCode == 200
        outputs:
          source: $response.body.args.source
          url: $url

      - stepId: call-tertiary
        operationId: "getPetById2"
        parameters:
          - name: petId
            in: path
            value: "123"
        successCriteria:
          - condition: $statusCode == 200
        outputs:
          source: $response.body.args.source
          url: $url

    outputs:
      primary_source: $steps.call-primary.outputs.source
      secondary_source: $steps.call-tertiary.outputs.source
      primary_url: $steps.call-primary.outputs.url
      secondary_url: $steps.call-tertiary.outputs.url
```

### Environment

Mac M5 Max running Tahoe 26.5.2
Rust 1.97.1
Arazzo-cli on main branch, last commit a7dff1e9
